description: This file defines React hooks and a utility function for progressive expansion processing. It includes a non-React utility to batch-process work items in an idle callback or fallback, and a React hook that manages UI state (progress, running status) around this utility. The primary purpose is to enable smooth, batched updates, such as expanding tree nodes, without blocking the main thread.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages batch-wise processing of a list of items, utilizing requestIdleCallback with setTimeout fallback. Supports starting, canceling, and progress tracking.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the controller, providing state management (running, progress, counts) and functions to start or cancel processing.
